name: nft-jump-unmatched-condition
description: jump guarded by an address we never send to, so the drop is never reached
setup: nft add chain inet f out "{ type filter hook output priority 0; policy accept; }"
nft add chain inet f sub
nft add rule inet f sub ip daddr 10.5.5.2 drop

action.spec: nft add rule inet f out ip daddr 10.9.9.9 jump sub
